subject: txn: implement staging for Pipelined DML (#51832)
summary: Reviewed af897798b9f9a5afbbbffa9d9a7e3518d28c74d5 vs first parent. The change enables MemBuffer staging for pipelined transactions (unionstore driver exposes Staging/Cleanup/Release), disables LazyTxn statement-buffer staging for pipelined txns to preserve pipelined DML semantics, removes the prior INSERT IGNORE ... ON DUPLICATE ... pipelined prohibition, and keeps mutation checker off for pipelined to maintain prior behavior. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in executor/session/store/table behavior; upstream/master retains the same core logic in these areas.
